description: Windows screen saver that runs MAME with a random game at set intervals
notes: This tool is no longer developed. Requires MAME and .NET Framework 4.6.
To use it as your screen saver, right-click $dir\Mamesaver.scr and choose Install (or copy it to C:\Windows\System32).
Use the 'Mamesaver Settings' shortcut to set the MAME path and rebuild the game list.
